title: Reflexive pronouns
summary: Use reflexive pronouns when the subject and object are the same person or thing.

explanation.en: Use myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves and themselves when an action comes back to the subject.
explanation.ru: Возвратные местоимения используются, когда действие направлено на самого исполнителя: myself, yourself, himself и т. д.

commonMistakes.wrong: She looked at her in the mirror.
commonMistakes.right: She looked at herself in the mirror.
commonMistakes.note: Use herself when subject and object are the same person.
By myself means alone / without help.
